movie:10935.overview: Harvard graduate James Averill serves as the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyoming, standing at the center of a conflict between impoverished immigrants and affluent cattle farmers. As tensions escalate, both Averill and Champion start to question their decisions.

movie:1318335.overview: Jean and Otto, a French newspaperman and a young German Francophile, are fighting for peace in Europe. Jean becomes a big press baron and an ardent advocate of collaboration with the occupying forces, while Otto becomes the Reich’s ambassador in Paris. Corinne, meanwhile, finds herself thrown into the lion’s pit.
